# The Winter Lab
Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics | College of Public Health | University of Georgia
:::
:::

::: {.content-container}
## A Policy-Driven Approach to Infectious Disease Research

We work directly with policymakers to shape research questions about infectious disease dynamics, population immunity, and public health interventions. This policy-driven approach connects three overlapping research areas:

::: {layout-ncol=3 .feature-cards}

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-bar-chart-line"></i> Transmission and Intervention Modelling
Mathematical and mechanistic models to characterize infectious disease dynamics and compare vaccination, surveillance, and other control strategies across populations and settings.

:::

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i> Prediction and Surveillance
Statistical and machine learning methods that combine case surveillance, vaccination data, population characteristics, and other signals to anticipate outbreaks and assess when available data can guide action.

:::

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-droplet"></i> Population Immunity and Seroepidemiology
Methods that use serological and other population data to identify immunity gaps, reconstruct patterns of exposure, and evaluate vaccination programs across pathogens with complex histories.

:::

:::
